findings.interpretation: Military cable clears the reviewed direct fixed-trader overlap screen and purchased copies do not satisfy the sampled spawned-in-session hideout construction requirements. Those facts only show that it is not a direct vanilla bypass. They do not establish a Relationship gameplay role: the item remains a raw component with no independent recurring field utility.

decision.reason: Relationship stock is quality-gated specialist availability, not a source of raw barter/material components. Military cable fails the independent recurring utility gate, so a safe Economy envelope cannot make it a valid Relationship offer and LL2 is allowed to remain empty.
reconsiderOnlyIf: the item gains a proven independent recurring field or specialist utility distinct from barter/hideout material value
a future Relationship doctrine explicitly changes the raw-material prohibition through a separately reviewed product decision
